name: Will the new drywall match the rest of the wall after storm damage repair?

mainEntity.name: Will the new drywall match the rest of the wall after storm damage repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: A good replacement should leave the wall dry, stable, and visually consistent with the rest of the room. That means the new drywall should be properly finished and textured so the repair blends in, not just covered over with paint.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, it should be finished to blend with the surrounding wall, including texture and surface smoothness. Matching depends on the original finish and how much of the wall had to be replaced.
